69100.meaning1: who does not follow instructions; who goes the wrong way

examples.text: sāmaṃ, adhiṭṭhāya, dūtena, dūtaparaṃparāya, visakkiyena dūtena, gatapaccāgatena dūtena, araho rahosaññī, raho arahosaññī, araho arahosaññī, raho rahosaññī

69104.meaning1: no agreement; not following the arrangement
69104.commentary: (VINa) visaṅketenā'ti ettha purebhattaṃ gacchissāmā'ti vatvā pacchābhattaṃ gacchanti, ajja vā gamissāmā'ti vatvā sve gacchanti. evaṃ kālavisaṅkete'y'eva anāpatti, dvāravisaṅkete pana maggavisaṅkete vā sati'pi āpatti'y'eva.

examples.text: anāpatti samaye, asaṃvidahitvā gacchati, bhikkhunī saṃvidahati, bhikkhu na saṃvidahati, visaṅketena gacchanti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayam'ajjhagā.
gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayam'ajjhagā.

69110.meaning1: become unconditioned; unconstructed; unfabricated; become disassembled
69110.commentary: (DHPa) visaṅkhāragataṃ cittan'ti idāni mama cittaṃ visaṅkhāraṃ nibbānaṃ ārammaṇakaraṇavasena gataṃ anupaviṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayam'ajjhagā.

69111.commentary: (NIDD1) visajjā'ti ganthe vosajjitvā vā, visajja. atha vā ganthe gadhite ganthite bandhe vibandhe ābandhe lagge laggite palibuddhe bandhane poṭayitvā, visajja. yathā vayhaṃ vā rathaṃ vā sakaṭaṃ vā sandamānikaṃ vā sajjaṃ visajjaṃ karonti vikopenti, evam'eva ganthe vosajjitvā, visajja. atha vā ganthe gadhite ganthite bandhe vibandhe ābandhe lagge laggite palibuddhe bandhane poṭayitvā visajjā'ti, ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajja. (SNPa) ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajjā'ti catubbidham'pi rūp'ādīnaṃ ādāyakattā ādānaganthaṃ attano cittasantāne gathitaṃ baddhaṃ ariyamaggasatthena visajja chinditvā.

examples.text: na kappayanti na purekkharonti, accantasuddhī'ti na te vadanti, ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajja, āsaṃ na kubbanti kuhiñci loke.

69112.construction:
vi + saṃ + √ñā + ā + a
visaññā + a
69112.commentary: (NIDD1) visaññasaññino vuccanti ummattakā ye ca khittacittā, na'pi so ummattako, no'pi khittacitto'ti

examples.text: na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.

69113.meaning1: with distorted perception; with deranged conception; (comm) mad
69113.commentary: (NIDD1) visaññasaññino vuccanti ummattakā ye ca khittacittā, na'pi so ummattako, no'pi khittacitto'ti

examples.text: na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.
saññasaññino vuccanti ye pakatisaññāya ṭhitā, na'pi so pakatisaññāya ṭhito. visaññasaññino vuccanti ummattakā ye ca khittacittā, na'pi so ummattako, no'pi khittacitto'ti.

69114.construction:
vi + saṃ + √ñā + ā + ī
visaññā + ī

examples.text: anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.

69115.construction:
vi + saṃ + √ñā + ā + ī
visaññā + ī
69115.commentary: (JAa) visaññīkaraṇiṃ pitvā, diṭṭhā n'āhumha vānarā'ti evarūpaṃ saññāvināsanato visaññīkaraṇiṃ suraṃ pivitvā etadeva sādhu, yaṃ vānarā n'āhumhā'ti. evaṃ te attano aguṇaṃ kathesuṃ.

examples.text: apāyimha anaccimha, agāyimha rudimha ca, visaññikaraṇiṃ pitvā, diṭṭhā n'āhumha vānarā'ti.
iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca, nappavedhenti tādino, ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ visaññuttaṃ, vayañ'c'ass'ānupassatī'ti.
so sukhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaññutto naṃ vedayati. dukkhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaññutto naṃ vedayati. adukkham'asukhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaññutto naṃ vedayati.
nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito no sarāgāya, visaññogāya dhammo desito no saññogāya, anupādānāya dhammo desito no saupādānāya!
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, majjhe nadiyā soto vikkhitto visaṭo byādiṇṇo n'eva dūraṅ'gamo assa na sīghasoto na hārahārī.
yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

69119.commentary: (DNa) na ca visaṭan'ti kakkaṭako viya akkhīni nīharitvā na kodhavasena pekkhitā ahosi.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno na ca visaṭaṃ, na ca visāci, na ca pana viceyya pekkhitā, ujuṃ tathā pasaṭam'ujumano, piyacakkhunā bahujanaṃ udikkhitā ahosi.
tatra, bhikkhave, ataramānassa bhāsato kāyo'pi na kilamati, cittam'pi na upahaññati, saro'pi na upahaññati, kaṇṭho'pi na āturīyati, visaṭṭham'pi hoti viññeyyaṃ ataramānassa bhāsitaṃ.
sañcetanikā sukkavisaṭṭhi aññatra supin'antā saṅgh'ādiseso.

69123.commentary: (SNPa) yassa ca evaṃ paṭipannassa bhikkhuno tāya paṭipadāya pahīnattā aṭṭhasa-tataṇhāvicarita-bhāvena visatattā visatā taṇhā n'atthi (NIDD1a) vuttañ'h'etaṃ suttan'ti kho, bhikkhave, nandirāgass'etaṃ adhivacanan'ti (saṃ. ni. 2.159). rūp'ādīsu vitthat'aṭṭhena visatā.

examples.text: yassa ca visatā n'atthi, chinnasotassa bhikkhuno, kicc'ākiccappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

69125.meaning1: fact of having poison; fact of being a toxin; fact of being venomous

69126.synonym: allīna, lagita, lagga, laggita, saṇṭhita, satta, saṃsaṭṭha

examples.text: etañ'ca sallaṃ paṭikacca disvā, ajjhositā yattha pajā visattā. jānāmi passāmi tath'eva etaṃ, ajjhositaṃ n'atthi tathāgatānan'ti.
tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke, ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan'ti.

69127.commentary: (ANa) visattikan'ti tattha tattha visattaṃ laggaṃ lagitaṃ. apica visamūlā'ti visattikā.

examples.text: taṇhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi jāliniṃ saritaṃ visaṭaṃ visattikaṃ, yāya ayaṃ loko uddhasto pariyonaddho tant'ākulakajāto gulāguṇṭhikajāto muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.
yassa jālinī visattikā, taṇhā n'atthi kuhiñci netave, taṃ buddham'anantagocaraṃ, apadaṃ kena padena nessatha.
yo kāme parivajjeti, sappass'eva padā siro, so imaṃ visattikaṃ loke, sato samativattati.

69129.synonym: parisuddha, vītaraja, saṃsuddha, suci, sucibhūta, sucīmant, suddha, suddhika
69129.commentary: (DNa) visado'va nikkhamatī'ti yathā aññe sattā yonimagge laggantā bhaggavibhaggā nikkhamanti, na evaṃ nikkhamati, alaggo hutvā nikkhamatī'ti attho udenā'ti udakena.

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado'va nikkhamati amakkhito udena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho

69132.meaning2: cleaning of the fundamentals, making clear

69136.meaning1: dissimilar; different (to); not alike; not equal

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sadhano sabhogo kantār'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya [sīlakkhandhavaggapāḷiyā kiñci visadisaṃ]
satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikantitvā esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya. esaniyā sallaṃ esitvā sallaṃ abbuheyya, apaneyya visadosaṃ saupādisesaṃ.

69138.meaning1: gone beyond the poisons; crossed over the toxins; (comm) (or) crossed over the uneven
69138.commentary: (ITIa) kāyavisam'ādikassa visamassa vantattā vā visasaṅkhātaṃ sabbaṃ kilesamalaṃ taritvā vā visaṃ sakalavaṭṭadukkhaṃ sayaṃ taritvā tāraṇato visantaro taṃ visan'taraṃ.

examples.text: tamonudaṃ pāragataṃ mah'esiṃ, taṃ pattipattaṃ vasimaṃ anāsavaṃ, visan'taraṃ taṇhakkhaye vimuttaṃ, taṃ ve muniṃ antimadehadhāriṃ, mārañ'jahaṃ brūmi jarāya pāraguṃ.

69139.meaning1: bowl of poison; cup of poison

examples.text: iṅgālakuyā'va ujjhito, visapatto'r'iva aggito kato, na'pi naṃ passāmi kīriso, atha maggena hato samūlako.
majjhatto majjhattaṭṭhāne'y'eva, appiyo appiyaṭṭhāne'y'eva, verī veriṭṭhāne'y'eva tiṭṭhati, liṅgavisabhāgakālakatā akhettam'eva.
322, 359. tathā dvande pāṇi-tūriya-yogga-sen'aṅga-khuddajantuka-vividhaviruddha-visabhāga-atth'ādīnañ'ca.
322, 359. tathā dvande pāṇi tūriya yogga sen'aṅga khuddajantuka vividhaviruddha visabhāg'attha-ādīnañ'ca.

69146.meaning1: adorned with speckled dots of different colours

examples.text: yassa paṭipāṭiyā dve tīṇi bhinnāni, tassa piṭṭhiyaṃ vā kucchiyaṃ vā uṭṭhitena visabhāgavaṇṇena kāḷaratt'ādīnaṃ aññataravaṇṇā gāvī viya sabalaṃ nāma hoti. yassa antar'antarā bhinnāni, tassa antar'antarā visabhāgabinduvicitrā gāvī viya kammāsaṃ nāma hoti.

69149.meaning1: (of a place) rough; uneven; dangerous; perilous
69149.notes: (MW) unevenness, uneven or rough ground or place

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.

69150.commentary: (NIDD1) yasmiṃ samaṃ visamaṃ vā'pi n'atthī'ti. yasmin'ti yasmiṃ puggale arahante khīṇ'āsave sadiso'ham'asmī'ti māno n'atthi, seyyo'ham'asmī'ti māno n'atthi, hīno'ham'asmī'ti omāno n'atthi na santi na saṃvijjati n'upalabbhati, pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭipassaddhaṃ abhabb'uppattikaṃ ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhan'ti, yasmiṃ samaṃ visamaṃ vā'pi n'atthi. (SNPa) yasmiṃ mādise khīṇ'āsave sadiso'ham'asmī'ti pavattiyā samaṃ vā, itaradvayabhāvena pavattiyā visamaṃ vā maññitaṃ n'atthi

examples.text: saccan'ti so brāhmaṇo kiṃ vadeyya, musā'ti vā so vivadetha kena, yasmiṃ samaṃ visamaṃ vā'pi n'atthi, sa kena vādaṃ paṭisaṃyujeyya.
kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkh'ūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.
idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.

69152.commentary: (ANa) visamā'ti na samā, atithaddhā vā atimudukā vā'ti attho. apañjasā'ti maggato apagatā, ummaggagāmino hutvā vāyantī'ti attho.

examples.text: visamaṃ mās'addhamāsesu parivattantesu visamaṃ utusaṃvaccharā parivattanti. visamaṃ utusaṃvaccharesu parivattantesu visamaṃ vātā vāyanti visamā apañjasā. visamaṃ vātesu vāyantesu visamesu apañjasesu devatā parikupitā bhavanti.
ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.
tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkamati. taṃ kissa hetu? m'āhaṃ khuddake pāṇe visamagate saṅghātaṃ āpādesin'ti!

tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, jegucchismiṃ hoti, so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, sato'va abhikkamāmi, sato'va paṭikkamāmi, yāva udakabindumhi'pi me dayā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, m'āhaṃ khuddake pāṇe visamagate saṅghātaṃ āpādesin'ti.
ubho khañjā ubho kuṇī, ubho visamacakkhukā, ubhinnaṃ piḷakā jātā, n'āhaṃ passāmi illisan'ti.

69157.meaning1: unwholesome conduct; immoral conduct; disharmonious behaviour; bad behaviour
69157.commentary: (MNa) visamā cariyā, visamassa vā kammassa cariyā'ti visamacariyā.

examples.text: yasmā ca kho, mahāli, ime dasa dhammā loke saṃvijjanti, tasmā paññāyati adhammacariyāvisamacariyā'ti vā dhammacariyāsamacariyā'ti vā'ti.
adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena adhammacārī visamacārī hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacārī visamacārī hoti, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacārī visamacārī hoti.

69159.commentary: (DNt) pabbatesu vā chinnataṭesu dur'ārohaṃ visamaṭṭhānaṃ. (ANt) visamaṭṭhānesū'ti papātādīsu visamaṭṭhānesu.

examples.text: pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.

69162.meaning1: fact of being (morally) unsuitable; fact of being wrong; fact of being out of tune

69163.meaning1: depending on rough terrain; relying on rugged terrain

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro nadīviduggaṃ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṃ vā.

69164.meaning1: depending on the unsuitable; relying on the wrong

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.

69165.meaning1: not taking good care of oneself; not looking after oneself; poor personal maintenance

69166.meaning1: produced by not taking good care of oneself; caused by not looking after oneself; due to poor personal maintenance
69166.commentary: (SNa) visamaparihārajānī'ti mahābhāravahana-sudhākoṭṭan'ādito vā avelāya carantassa sappaḍaṃsakūpapāt'ādito vā visamaparihārato jātāni. (NIDD1a) visamaparihārajā'ti atiṭṭhānanisajj'ādinā visamaparihārena jātā.

examples.text: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

seyyath'idaṃ… pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā vātasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā sannipātikā ābādhā utupariṇāmajā ābādhā visamaparihārajā ābādhā opakkamikā ābādhā kammavipākajā ābādhā sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo'ti.

69167.commentary: (ANa) visamapākāni sassāni bhavantī'ti ekasmiṃ ṭhāne gabbhīni honti, ekasmiṃ sañjātakhīrāni, ekaṃ ṭhānaṃ paccatī'ti evaṃ visamaṃ pākāni sassāni bhavanti.

examples.text: deve na sammā dhāraṃ anuppavecchante visamapākāni sassāni bhavanti. visamapākāni, bhikkhave, sassāni manussā paribhuñjantā app'āyukā honti dubbaṇṇā ca bavh'ābādhā ca.

69168.commentary: (ANa) visamapākāni sassāni bhavantī'ti ekasmiṃ ṭhāne gabbhīni honti, ekasmiṃ sañjātakhīrāni, ekaṃ ṭhānaṃ paccatī'ti evaṃ visamaṃ pākāni sassāni bhavanti.

examples.text: deve na sammā dhāraṃ anuppavecchante visamapākīni sassāni bhavanti. visamapākīni, bhikkhave, sassāni manussā paribhuñjantā app'āyukā honti dubbaṇṇā ca bavh'ābādhā ca.

69170.commentary: (DNa) visamalobho'ti paribhogayuttesu'pi ṭhānesu atibalavalobho. (MNa) tattha sakabhaṇḍe chandarāgo abhijjhā, parabhaṇḍe visamalobho.

examples.text: abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkileso, byāpādo cittassa upakkileso, kodho cittassa upakkileso, upanāho cittassa upakkileso, makkho cittassa upakkileso
ariyasāvako abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkileso'ti, iti viditvā abhijjhāvisamalobhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.

69171.meaning1: overcome by unsuitable greed; overwhelmed by immoral desire; (comm) greed for the possessions and property of others
69171.commentary: (ANa) visamalobh'ābhibhūtā'ti lobhassa samakālo nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ visamo'va esa. attanā pariggahitavatthumhi pana uppajjamāno samalobho nāma, parapariggahitavatthumhi uppajjamāno'va visamo'ti adhippeto.

examples.text: eta'r'ahi, brāhmaṇa, manussā adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā. te adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā tiṇhāni satthāni gahetvā aññam'aññaṃ jīvitā voropenti, tena bahū manussā kālaṃ karonti.

69173.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of visama, neg

examples.text: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.

69174.meaning1: with poisonous root; (comm) resulting in suffering

examples.text: kodhaṃ chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ chetvā na socati, kodhassa visamūlassa, madhur'aggassa devate, vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañ'hi chetvā na socatī'ti.
na maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, hit'ānukampī evaṃ vadesi, ahit'ānukampī maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, evaṃ vadesi. tuyhañ'hi, pāpima, evaṃ hoti, yesaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desessati, te me visayaṃ upātivattissantī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.

69185.meaning1: removed the arrow; free from the barb
69185.meaning2: free from grief, removed of the dart
69185.commentary: (SNPa) tattha katame pañca sallā? rāgasallo, dosasallo, mohasallo, mānasallo, diṭṭhisallo'ti vuttānaṃ pañcannaṃ sallānaṃ vigatattā visallo.

examples.text: yo nīvaraṇe pahāya pañca, anigho tiṇṇakathaṃkatho visallo, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

69186.grammar: adj, masc gen pl of visalla, irreg
69186.meaning1: of those who have removed the arrow; of those free from the barb

examples.text: ye sattasārā anīghā nirāsā, paccekam'ev'ajjhagamaṃsu bodhiṃ, tesaṃ visallāna nar'uttamānaṃ, nāmāni me kittayato suṇātha.

69188.meaning1: trading in poisons; dealing in deadly substances
69188.commentary: (SNa) visavaṇijjā'ti visaṃ kāretvā tassa vikkayo… iti sabbam'pi imaṃ vaṇijjaṃ n'eva attanā kātuṃ, na pare samādapetvā kāretuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, vaṇijjā upāsakena akaraṇīyā. katamā pañca? satthavaṇijjā, sattavaṇijjā, maṃsavaṇijjā, majjavaṇijjā, visavaṇijjā.

69191.commentary: (DNa) visavijjā'ti yāya, purāṇavisaṃ vā rakkhanti, navavisaṃ vā karonti visavantam'eva vā.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… aṅgavijjā vatthuvijjā khattavijjā sivavijjā bhūtavijjā bhūrivijjā ahivijjā visavijjā vicchikavijjā mūsikavijjā sakuṇavijjā vāyasavijjā pakkajjhānaṃ saraparittāṇaṃ migacakkaṃ

69192.commentary: (DNa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhivipajjanabhāvāya, punappunaṃ āsevanavasena ciṇṇavasitāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (NIDD1a) visavitāya buddho'ti nānāguṇavikasanato padumam'iva vikasan'aṭṭhena buddho'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (PMa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti vividhaṃ visesaṃ savati janeti pavattetī'ti visavī, vividhaṃ savanaṃ vā assa atthī'ti visavī, tassa bhāvo visavitā. tassā visavitāya, iddhiyā vividha-visesa-pavattana-bhāvāyā'ti attho. (DNt) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhiyā nipphādane yogyabhāvāya. anek'atthattā hi dhātūnaṃ yogy'attho vi-pubbo su-saddo, visavanaṃ vā pajjanaṃ visavitā, tattha kāmakāritā visavitā.

examples.text: ime kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro iddhipādā paññattā iddhipahutāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivikubbanatāya.

69193.commentary: (DNa) visavī'ti ciṇṇavasī. (DNt) visavanaṃ visavo, kāmakāro vasitā, so etassa atthī'ti visavī'ti āha ciṇṇavasī'ti.

examples.text: atha ce'pi pabbajati so manujo, dhammesu hoti paguṇo visavī, tass'ānusāsaniguṇ'ābhirato, anvāyiko bahujano bhavatī'ti.
handa carahi te, mārisa, passa antaradhāyāmī'ti. handa carahi me tvaṃ, brahme, antaradhāyassu, sace visahasī'ti.
eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.
idh'ūragānaṃ pavaro paviṭṭho, selassa vaṇṇena pamokkham'icchaṃ, brahmañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ apacāyamāno, bubhukkhito no visahāmi bhottuṃ.
